note: Firmware part of six nozzle switches from Bambu Studio 02.05.03.61 dual-nozzle H2D slices (comments and progress lines removed). Only the macro commands are kept; no geometry or settings. See maps/reference/bambu.md.

switches.name: 0.4 mm, first change to nozzle 1
lines: M993 A2 B2 C2 ; nozzle cam detection allow status save.
M993 A0 B0 C0 ; nozzle cam detection not allowed.
M1015.4 S1 K0 ;disable E air printing detect
M993 A3 B3 C3 ; nozzle cam detection allow status restore.
M1015.4 S1 K1 H0.4 ;enable E air printing detect
M620.6 I1 W1 ;enable ams air printing detect
